info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Credit Card Position Tracking API
info.description: The Credit Card Position Tracking API provides real-time insights into the status of credit card transactions and balances. This endpoint allows users to query specific credit card positions by unique identifiers. It is designed for financial institutions, account holders, and developers integrating credit card data into their applications. By using this API, businesses can enhance customer experiences with up-to-date credit card information, enabling informed decisions and effective financial management.

get.summary: Retrieve the position of a specific credit card.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current position details for the specified credit card identified by its unique CARD identifier. It provides important information regarding the card's status and other relevant data points.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the parameters needed to retrieve the position of a specific credit card identified by CARD-400045. It includes all relevant attributes required for the operation to return accurate information about the credit card's status and details.

200.description: Successfully retrieved credit card position details.
